CheckTitle: IAM user active access keys are rotated within 90 days
Description: **Huawei Cloud IAM** permanent access keys (`AK/SK`) that are **active** should be rotated at least every **90 days**.
Risk: Long-lived permanent access keys increase the window of exposure if credentials are leaked or compromised, enabling unauthorized programmatic access to cloud resources.

Code.Other:
1. Log on to the **Huawei Cloud console**.
2. Navigate to **Identity and Access Management (IAM)** > **Users**.
3. Select the target user and open **Security Settings** > **Access Keys**.
4. Create a new access key, update dependent applications, and disable/delete the old access key.

Recommendation.Text: Rotate active IAM permanent access keys every **90 days** or migrate workloads to temporary security credentials / IAM agencies.
